SALEM, Ore., Nov. 5, 2026 — Agility® (Nasdaq: AGLT), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today became the first U.S. publicly listed pure-play humanoid robotics company with proven, active commercial deployments. Agility's common stock and warrants will begin trading today on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker symbols “AGLT” and “AGLTW,” respectively, following completion of its previously announced business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI. The business combination and related financings represent approximately $465 million in gross capital raised before transaction expenses.

Agility enters the public markets with a differentiated foundation for commercializing humanoid robotics: nearly three years of real-world deployment experience, more than 65,000 hours of operation, committed multi-year customer orders and U.S.-based infrastructure designed to manufacture, deploy and support robots at scale. The company has secured more than $300 million in committed multi-year orders for Digit® 5, its next-generation humanoid robot, subject to contractual milestones, product features and specifications.

“Today marks an important milestone for Agility, but the bigger story is what it means for the future of work,” said Peggy Johnson, CEO of Agility Robotics. “AI is moving beyond the digital world and into the physical world, creating new possibilities for how people and machines work together. At Agility, that future is already taking shape. Digit is doing real work in customer operations today, taking on repetitive, physically demanding tasks. Becoming a public company gives us access to more resources to help accelerate that progress, bring intelligent robots to more workplaces and help build a future where people and robots accomplish more together.”

Agility’s flagship humanoid robot, Digit, is designed to perform useful work in environments built for people, helping businesses address persistent labor shortages and automate repetitive, physically demanding tasks. Digit is already operating with leading global enterprises including GXO, Schaeffler and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada.

The company’s next-generation Digit 5 platform builds on years of real-world customer experience and is designed for cooperatively safe work, with the goal of enabling robots and people to operate in closer proximity. Digit 5 is designed to perform a broader range of industrial tasks, supported by Agility’s proprietary robotics and physical AI technology, safety systems and Agility Arc™ enterprise software platform.

Recent milestones demonstrate Agility’s progress toward broader commercial adoption:

  • Growing Commercial Deployments and Pipeline: Agility recently expanded its partnership with GXO to deploy Digit at two additional U.S. logistics facilities in early 2027, building on the companies’ pioneering commercial deployment in Georgia, where Digit has moved more than 100,000 totes. The company’s growing customer base also includes AGCO, which has signed a commercial agreement for a Digit pilot expected to begin in 2027, and three additional enterprise manufacturing customers participating in paid programs focused on specific manufacturing applications: a major global automaker, one of the world’s largest automotive technology and components developers, and a leading global consumer products manufacturer. Agility also has an active pipeline of more than 30 prospective customers across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, logistics, consumer products and defense.
  • Strong Demand for Digit 5: Digit 5, unveiled in September 2026, has received more than $300 million in committed multi-year orders subject to satisfaction of contractual milestones, product features and specifications. The new platform incorporates significant advances developed in response to years of customer feedback. These include proprietary cycloidal actuator technology engineered to support repetitive lifting of up to 50 pounds, interchangeable end effectors and expanded manipulation capabilities designed to automate a broader range of industrial workflows. Early customer access is expected to begin in the first half of 2027, with general availability targeted for the end of 2027.
  • Advancing Safety, Physical AI and Performance: Agility continues to advance its proprietary robotics and physical AI platform, supported by collaborations with NVIDIA, FORT Robotics and Nyobolt. The company recently announced plans to standardize Digit 5's onboard compute on NVIDIA IGX Thor and expand its integration of NVIDIA Halos safety technology. Its partnership with FORT Robotics supports the development of safety systems for industrial environments, while Nyobolt's ultra-fast charging battery technology is designed to enable Digit 5 to recharge in just nine minutes and deliver more than 20 hours of productive work in a 24-hour day.
  • Building for Commercial Scale: Agility has invested in the U.S. infrastructure needed to manufacture, deploy and support humanoid robots at scale. This includes RoboFab®, its 70,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Salem, Oregon, designed for annual production capacity of up to 10,000 robots; its Fremont, California, facility in Silicon Valley focused on hardware and physical AI development; and its recently announced 50,000-square-foot Pittsburgh expansion, which will strengthen software, AI, deployment and customer support capabilities. These investments are complemented by Agility Arc™, its cloud-based platform for managing robot fleets and integrating them into customer operations.

The business combination and related financings raised approximately $465 million in gross capital before transaction expenses, including proceeds from a private investment in public equity (PIPE) led by Foxconn and $100 million of equity funding received prior to closing. Agility intends to use the proceeds to support fulfillment of customer orders, expand commercial deployments, scale Digit production and continue advancing its integrated robotics and physical AI platform.

Headquartered in Salem, Oregon, with offices in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and Fremont, California, Agility's mission is to build robot partners that augment the human workforce. Our groundbreaking general-purpose humanoid robot, Digit, is the first multi-purpose, human-centric robot that is Made for Work® and commercially deployed today. With more than 65,000 hours of real-world operation combined with industry-leading safety standards, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential. To learn more, visit agilityrobotics.com.

俄勒冈州塞勒姆，2026年11月5日 — 领先的人形机器人与物理人工智能公司Agility®（纳斯达克股票代码：AGLT）今日成为首家在美国公开上市、专注于人形机器人业务，并拥有经过验证且正在运行的商业部署的公司。在完成此前宣布的与Churchill Capital Corp XI的业务合并后，Agility的普通股和认股权证将于今日开始在纳斯达克股票市场交易，交易代码分别为“AGLT”和“AGLTW”。此次业务合并及相关融资在扣除交易费用前共筹集约4.65亿美元资金。

Agility进入公开市场时，已为人形机器人的商业化奠定了差异化基础：近三年的实际部署经验、超过65,000小时的运行时间、客户承诺的多年期订单，以及位于美国、旨在支持机器人大规模制造、部署和服务的基础设施。公司已为其下一代人形机器人Digit® 5获得超过3亿美元的多年期承诺订单，这些订单以满足合同里程碑、产品功能和规格要求为条件。

Agility Robotics首席执行官Peggy Johnson表示：“今天是Agility的一个重要里程碑，但更重要的是，这对工作的未来意味着什么。人工智能正从数字世界走向物理世界，为人与机器协同工作创造新的可能。在Agility，这样的未来已经开始成形。如今，Digit正在客户的运营中承担实际工作，执行重复性、体力要求高的任务。成为上市公司让我们能够获得更多资源，帮助加快这一进程，将智能机器人带到更多工作场所，并助力构建一个人与机器人携手取得更多成果的未来。”

Agility的旗舰人形机器人Digit旨在为人类建造的环境中执行有用的工作，帮助企业应对持续的劳动力短缺，并将重复性、体力要求高的任务自动化。Digit已经在GXO、Schaeffler和Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada等全球领先企业投入运行。

公司的下一代Digit 5平台建立在多年的客户实际使用经验之上，旨在实现安全协作，目标是让机器人与人能够在更近的距离内工作。在Agility专有的机器人与物理人工智能技术、安全系统以及Agility Arc™企业软件平台的支持下，Digit 5旨在执行更广泛的工业任务。

近期的里程碑展示了Agility在扩大商业应用方面取得的进展：

  • 持续扩大的商业部署与潜在客户储备： Agility近期扩大了与GXO的合作，将于2027年初在另外两座美国物流设施部署Digit。这建立在双方于佐治亚州开展的开创性商业部署基础之上，Digit已在那里搬运了超过100,000个周转箱。公司不断扩大的客户群还包括AGCO，该公司已签署Digit试点项目的商业协议，预计于2027年启动；此外，还有三家制造业企业客户正在参与针对特定制造应用的付费项目，分别是一家全球大型汽车制造商、一家全球规模最大的汽车技术与零部件开发商之一，以及一家全球领先的消费品制造商。Agility还在积极接洽超过30家潜在客户，覆盖汽车、制造、航空航天、物流、消费品和国防等行业。
  • Digit 5需求强劲： 2026年9月发布的Digit 5已获得超过3亿美元的多年期承诺订单，这些订单以满足合同里程碑、产品功能和规格要求为条件。新平台融入了根据多年客户反馈开发的重大改进，包括旨在支持反复举起最高50磅重物的专有摆线执行器技术、可更换的末端执行器，以及旨在将更广泛工业工作流程自动化的增强物体操作能力。预计客户将于2027年上半年开始获得早期使用机会，目标是在2027年底全面上市。
  • 推进安全、物理人工智能与性能： 在与NVIDIA、FORT Robotics和Nyobolt合作的支持下，Agility持续推进其专有的机器人与物理人工智能平台。公司近期宣布，计划将Digit 5的机载计算统一采用NVIDIA IGX Thor，并扩大对NVIDIA Halos安全技术的集成。与FORT Robotics的合作支持面向工业环境的安全系统开发；Nyobolt的超快充电电池技术则旨在使Digit 5仅需九分钟即可完成充电，并在24小时内提供超过20小时的有效工作时间。
  • 为商业规模化建设基础： Agility已投资建设在美国大规模制造、部署和支持人形机器人所需的基础设施。其中包括位于俄勒冈州塞勒姆、占地70,000平方英尺的RoboFab®制造工厂，设计年产能最高为10,000台机器人；位于硅谷加利福尼亚州弗里蒙特、专注于硬件与物理人工智能开发的设施；以及近期宣布的匹兹堡50,000平方英尺扩建项目，该项目将加强软件、人工智能、部署及客户支持能力。与这些投资相配套的还有Agility Arc™，这是其用于管理机器人机群并将其整合到客户运营中的云平台。

此次业务合并及相关融资在扣除交易费用前共筹集约4.65亿美元资金，其中包括由Foxconn领投的上市公司私募股权融资（PIPE）所得款项，以及在交割前收到的1亿美元股权融资。Agility计划将所得款项用于支持客户订单的履行、扩大商业部署、提升Digit产量，并继续推进其一体化机器人与物理人工智能平台。

Agility总部位于俄勒冈州塞勒姆，并在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡和加利福尼亚州弗里蒙特设有办公室，其使命是打造能够增强人类劳动力能力的机器人伙伴。我们突破性的通用人形机器人Digit，是首款以人为中心、Made for Work®（为工作而生）且现已投入商业部署的多用途机器人。凭借超过65,000小时的实际运行经验以及行业领先的安全标准，我们正在开创一个提升人类潜能的自动化新时代。欲了解更多信息，请访问agilityrobotics.com。

Agility、Agility标志、Digit、Agility Arc、RoboFab和Made for Work均为Agility Robotics, Inc.的商标。保留所有权利。第三方商标归其各自所有者所有。
